subject: E-Commerce
title: Subscribe and Save
description: A short lesson to help you apply Subscribe and Save.

hook.text: Amazon's Subscribe and Save lets you auto-reorder items monthly at a 15% discount. It locks in habits.

buildup.text: Subscription models guarantee recurring revenue. Amazon applied this to toothpaste, diapers, and dog food.

discovery.text: Once customers auto-subscribe, they stop comparing prices elsewhere. Switching costs are psychological.

twist.text: Amazon quietly raises base prices on subscribed items over time. Most customers never notice the creep.

climax.text: Subscribe and Save turns one-time buyers into lifetime customers. Convenience becomes a cage.

punchline.text: 15% off, auto-ship monthly. Convenience quietly killed price comparison.

quiz.question: Why is Subscribe and Save so effective for Amazon?
